title: Create KairoNova AI Chatbot Website (branding + landing + demo chat)

requirements.text: Create a coherent KairoNova brand identity across the website, including a consistent visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for a premium AI chatbot brand; avoid blue/purple as primary colors.

quotes: No ur wish create website alone

acceptanceCriteria: All pages share a consistent theme (color palette, typography, and layout rules).
Primary theme does not rely on blue/purple as the main brand colors.
Site looks intentional and polished on both mobile and desktop.

requirements.text: Implement a public Landing page for the KairoNova chatbot brand that clearly presents: product name “KairoNova”, tagline, brief description, and creator attribution “Developed by Kairav”, with calls-to-action that navigate to the Chat experience.

acceptanceCriteria: Landing page displays “KairoNova” prominently.
Landing page includes visible text “Developed by Kairav”.
A clear “Start Chat” (or equivalent) CTA navigates to the chat screen.

requirements.text: Implement a Chat page that provides a ChatGPT-like UI (message list, user input box, send button, loading indicator) and supports an on-chain demo chatbot response flow without using any external AI/LLM APIs (e.g., simple rules-based responses, canned replies, or scripted behaviors).

acceptanceCriteria: User can enter a message and see it appear in the conversation timeline.
App produces a bot response for each user message without calling external AI services.
UI shows a loading/typing state while generating the bot reply.
Conversation remains usable after multiple turns (at least 10 messages).

requirements.text: Add basic informational pages and navigation: About (describing KairoNova and attribution to Kairav), and Privacy/Disclaimer (stating this is a demo chatbot experience and does not provide professional advice).

acceptanceCriteria: Top-level navigation (or footer links) provides access to Landing, Chat, About, and Privacy/Disclaimer.
About page includes “Developed by Kairav”.
Privacy/Disclaimer page is reachable and readable on mobile.

requirements.text: Implement backend persistence in the single Motoko actor to store and retrieve chat sessions/messages for the current user/device context (simple session model is acceptable), and expose canister methods consumed by the frontend via the existing actor hook pattern.

quotes: No ur wish create website alone

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes methods to append a message and fetch conversation history.
Frontend can load prior messages from the backend on page load/refresh for the current session model.
All Motoko logic remains within the single main actor file (no extra backend services).

requirements.text: Use React Query for chat data flow (loading history, sending messages, receiving bot replies) with appropriate loading/error UI states so the chat remains responsive and failures are visible to the user.

quotes: No ur wish create website alone

acceptanceCriteria: Chat history query has loading and error states.
Send message action is implemented as a mutation with optimistic or clearly staged UI updates.
Errors are presented in the UI in English (no silent failures).

requirements.text: Add basic SEO/accessibility essentials: meaningful page titles, semantic headings, and keyboard-accessible chat input controls.

quotes: No ur wish create website alone

acceptanceCriteria: Each page sets a sensible document/page title including “KairoNova”.
Chat input can be focused and submitted via keyboard.
Primary headings use semantic h1/h2 structure.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not integrate external AI/LLM services or third-party auth providers (Internet Identity only if later requested).
nonGoals: Implementing a real ChatGPT/LLM backend or connecting to OpenAI/Anthropic/other AI services.
Social login providers beyond Internet Identity.
